title: Raw X-ray diffraction data for Thiourea at 130 K - Low temperature phase - non-modulated
creator: Antonio L. Llamas-Saiz, Universidad de Santiago de Compostela

solver_inputs.source_population: 9047 corrected unmerged observations, including 544 negative intensities

qualification: Exploratory experimental development case, not an untouched holdout or an inorganic-material validation panel. The source includes hydrogen atoms and anisotropic displacement; the initial solver uses a common isotropic U and excludes H. Published and native R1 use different models/populations and are not an equal-objective comparison.
